description: Extract the required contract clauses, map each declared obligation to its supporting sentence, and report the coverage and the gaps. When a contract or policy needs its clause coverage and evidence mapped quickly. Do not choose this when you need legal interpretation or advice, which needs a lawyer. Example requests: Extract the key clauses from this contract and report what is missing. | Map my obligations to the sentences that evidence them. | Is this contract complete for a data-processing review? | Run a compliance evidence check over this agreement.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

contract.description: The customer's contract.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The contract or policy text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

obligations.description: The customer's obligations.txt, as text. Supported: Text. Obligations as 'clause_kind=phrase' lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_compliance_evidence_pack

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Compliance evidence pack
